## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Verification

List automated checks and manual verification performed.

## Checklist

- [ ] I kept this change focused and reviewed my own diff.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] I updated public docs when commands, configuration, or behavior changed.
- [ ] I ran `pnpm check` successfully.
- [ ] I removed secrets, private vault content, generated output, and local state.
- [ ] I called out breaking changes, migrations, and security implications.
